profile.headline: Senior Systems Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer skilled in both frontend and backend development. Proficient in a variety of development languages and frameworks, with expertise in modern web and mobile applications as well as industrial systems. Experienced leadership and mentorship roles, guiding teams to successful project outcomes. Technologies: Vue, Javascript/Typescript, NativescriptVue, Android, iOS, Angular, C#.NET, GraphQL, SQL Server, Git, Jira.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications using Angular and TypeScript within a microfrontend architecture. Leveraging tools such as Syncfusion, AG Grid, and AG Charts, while contributing to the development and maintenance of reusable shared component libraries across multiple projects.

On the backend, building and enhancing .NET-based APIs following microservices architecture, CQRS, and Clean Architecture principles. Working with SQL Server, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch to deliver efficient and reliable data solutions.

Actively supporting team success through mentoring, task coordination, and stepping into leadership responsibilities when needed. Over the past year, expanded scope of ownership, contributing to both technical excellence and team collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Angular · TypeScript · Nx · Syncfusion · .NET Framework · .NET APIs · .NET Core · .NET C# · Elasticsearch · Microsoft SQL Server · Docker · Azure DevOps · Mentoring

positions.title: Front End Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Development of web/mobile application using Vue, Nativescript Vue framework with typescript. 
Development of mobile application using Android with Kotlin. 
Implementation of native Android and iOS features using native APIs to enhance the functionality of the application.
Development of GraphQL queries/mutations to access/update data needed for the application.
Implementation of dependencies upgrades, handling conflicts, and breaking changes effectively.
Mentor team members in the development of the application and features.
Development applying functional programming approach.
Management and development of career framework for the team.
Leadership in the development of web and native mobile application projects.
Technical presentations to improve knowledge about new technologies.
Programming Languages and Tools: Mobile Development, NativescriptVue, Vue.js, Typescript, iOS/Objective-C, android/Kotlin, android/Java, GraphQL, Apollo Client,  fp-ts library, Git, Visual Studio Code, Agile, SCRUM
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · HTML · JavaScript · Vue.js · GraphQL

positions.title: Web Systems Developer
positions.description:
Developed mobile application using Nativescript Vue framework with typescript.
Implemented native Android and iOS APIs to increase the functionality of the implemented features.
Developed GraphQL queries/mutations to access/update data needed for the application.
Implemented dependencies upgrades solving conflicts and breaking changes required for the upgrades.
Mentored junior team members in the development of the application and features.
Tech used: Nativescript, Vue, typescript, Java, Objective-C, android, iOS, GraphQL, Apollo Client.
positions.insights: Skills: iOS · TypeScript · HTML · Android · JavaScript · Objective-C · Vue.js · GraphQL · NativeScript

positions.title: Senior System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed Management Web Application for department usability, resulting in improved production system analysis.
•	Deployed improvements on several web applications with Angular / .NET Core, accomplishing an increase in usability and satisfied users. 
•	Implemented the software development SCRUM agile methodology that engendered a collaborated team.
•	Solved through troubleshooting and testing identified issues before software deployment. 
•	Led a project-based team of 3 other software engineers, supervising their work and output.

positions.title: Specialist Systems Engineer
positions.locationName: San Nicolás de los Arroyos, Argentina
positions.description:
•	Deployed software development life cycle in multiple software environments for several web applications in Angular / .NET Core.
•	Communicated with customers about progress updates, gathered feedback, and worked to resolve specific concerns.
•	Spearheaded the redevelopment for technology update - ASP .NET to Angular - of the main operative management system providing a grand impact on the company.
•	Supervised teams of 7 other software engineers ensuring they used their maximum potential and abilities, delivered consistent coaching and constructive feedback.
•	Collaborated closely with Coordinators and Managers to keep projects on track and meet deadlines.
•	Coordinated jointly with a cross country team to accomplish both the specific requirements of each factory and the common ones.
•	Implemented the software development life cycle for both management -client/server- applications and operational, improving the interaction between the factory operators and the production process.
•	Deployed software development life cycle for several management web applications, accomplished better communication between departments.
•	Worked closely with team members and supervisors to deliver project requirements, develop solutions and meet deadlines.
•	Expanded systems with new features and structural components.
•	Troubleshot, tested and remedied identified issues before software deployment.
•	Improved Inter-process communication libraries with new technologies.
•	Trained end-users in best practices to work on their system.
